messages.subject: RKWard and importing Excel files
messages.body_plain:
I am currently running 0.7.5 RKWard on KDE Neon (based on Ubuntu 22.04). 
I am trying to import a simple .xlsx (or .xls) file with 3 sheets and 
only 1 to 2 dozen rows with a few columns....something very basic. I 
have loaded the gdata package (as well as others that I have seen 
recommended). But whenever I import data and select Excel (Perl), it 
produces the error shown in the screenshot below. I assure you that I 
have the gdata package both installed and loaded. I have even tried two 
different versions of this package. Any help would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks!

Mark

messages.subject: RKWard and importing Excel files
messages.body_plain:
A work around could be to using package `rio`,
>From menu "file -> import" -> "format of importation" -> "Generic
importation (based on rio)"
(This names may not be the exactly right, I'ḿ using the spanish translated
version).
Just tick the option "import a list with all data sets" to get the three
sheets.
This is what I use to import Excel files.
I've used Java with the package "XLConnect" but some versions of Java won't
work. It has nice features though.
Regards.
Alfonso
